About

Exploring how language models use evidence—and understand the limits of their knowledge.

My work explores retrieval-augmented generation and preference alignment, with an interest in helping language models give reliable answers and recognize when to abstain.

This page brings together selected research and ways to get in touch. For my full publication record, please visit Google Scholar ↗.
